safety_correction: Do not train on every immediate safe crossing. Only retain causal preferences where preferred_add is exact-DP optimal and deferred_add is not exact-DP optimal at the causal predecessor.
interpretation: The feasibility hypothesis survives only with the DP-consistency filter. All predecessor states were already present in V9 on-policy supervision, so the new causal information is a boundary-focused sampling/reweighting scheme rather than new action-value labels. This is a controlled correction to V9 supervision dilution, not a new generic advantage objective.
